doc: shield_texture = 0, cumulus_max = 0, a_fine = 0: the coverage is the bare shield ramp clip(0.5 + u / ramp, 0, 1) even with streak and sub-texel arrays given (the cumulus is 0 so the binomial term is 0). Pipeline dtypes; tolerance is 2x the golden float32 default (a one-ulp change of s moves the narrow ramp by 3e-7 where the coverage is small). Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 0; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.7e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 12x the larger of the two spreads.
